# MATRA VASTRA

> Premium culture-rooted clothing brand from Varanasi (Kashi), India. Oversized 240 GSM cotton T-shirts across three collections. Tagline: "Wear Your Roots. Represent Your Culture."

Key facts: based in Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh, India; prices ₹999–₹1,399; sizes S–XXL; free shipping over ₹999 (else ₹79); payments via Razorpay (UPI, cards, netbanking, wallets); 7-day exchange; coupon KASHI10 for 10% off; bulk/custom printing from 10 pieces; WhatsApp +91 6393707020; email hello@matravastra.com.

## Collections
- [Kashi / Spiritual](https://matravastra-3d--2jt027np.preview.emergentagent.com/collection/kashi): Mahadev, Ganga aarti and ghat artwork in black and antique gold.
- [Apna Purvanchal](https://matravastra-3d--2jt027np.preview.emergentagent.com/collection/purvanchal): Regional pride, Bhojpuri typography and folk heritage.
- [Aspirant Life](https://matravastra-3d--2jt027np.preview.emergentagent.com/collection/aspirant): Minimal oversized tees for students and aspirants.
